criteria.notes: The supplied Veszprem tourism map remains the primary surface, with destination search, explicit routes, detail states, and reset behavior around it.
The original map composition, labels, landmarks, current-location pin, and colors remain intact; the app does not redraw or reinterpret the source artwork.
The visitor-map composition, quiet map hit areas, restrained tourism palette, and source-led details are distinct from generic dashboard examples.
Primary controls and directory names satisfy the near-viewing text floors at both accepted surfaces; map labels retain source resolution.
Light, dark, and custom interface palettes retain clear text, control, selection, and route contrast without recoloring the reference map.
Long title and destination states remain complete without clipped glyphs; destination rows wrap and selected names auto-fit.
The map stays fully inspectable and dominant at 1920x1080 and 1366x768 while the directory, detail view, and keyboard remain bounded.
The packaged WebP preserves the supplied 1341x947 artwork, loads without external dependencies, and has a designed unavailable state.
The example follows the supplied map instead of copying card, KPI, pagination, or palette grammar from unrelated examples.

screenshots.notes: Full source map and continuously scrollable destination directory fill the accepted Full-HD surface without unintended overflow.
Compact layout preserves map context, touch targets, and 14px destination names.
The Laczkó Museum route follows the reviewed street and park corridor around the library footprint, with no cross-building shortcut.
The Heroes Gate route leaves the current marker north-west, stays on the visible street corridor, and reaches the reviewed west-side entrance.
The Auer House route follows Boglyavari Street and reaches the reviewed east-side entrance without the previous start hairpin.
The Gyarkert route follows Kossuth and Budapest streets around the striped building footprint.
Named default scenario matches the accepted Full-HD composition.
Dark compact interface keeps sufficient contrast around the unchanged source map.
Custom palette consistently updates interface colors while preserving map fidelity.
Empty bound data keeps the map useful and presents a stable directory empty state.
Off-map destination metadata remains available without an invented route.
The large app-owned Hungarian keyboard, typed-value field, language controls, and close action are fully visible and touch-readable.
Updated destination metadata and the START badge remain bounded after live table replacement.
The long Hungarian landmark name wraps within a complete touch target.
The long selected name auto-fits without clipping route metrics or actions.
The long kiosk title remains complete in the accepted compact header.
Direct row-array input produces the same stable destination directory.
